basis: Reuses core, cartridge, bare 6S pack and lift accounting from system_design.json. Replaces the earlier wheeled suction duster only. Ground vacuum, mop and sofa modules retain drive.

boom.density_basis: Material estimate; actual tube grade, tolerances and mass to verify
boom.tool_reach_datum: 610 mm total path: 480 mm upward spar + 100 mm horizontal over-edge wrist + 30 mm drop. Horizontal reach is shorter; this is a declared interpretation of the owner's approximate 2 ft tool, not 610 mm beyond the guards.
boom.notes: Fixed 45-degree keyed root and horizontal head; station detaches/parks the spar, no carried telescope or arm motor. Thin hook approaches a stopped blade from its edge; blade edge geometry and compliance still need qualification. Clean by aircraft translation, not by tilting the whole aircraft into contact. No powered folding motion is modeled. Revision E routes the tool behind the core; flight approaches with the tool end leading. This is a redesigned rear socket, not arbitrary rotation of the keyed module connector.

hardware.name: Open bottom frame, four posts, metal module seats and studs
hardware.basis: 65 cm3 effective PETG at 1.27 g/cm3 plus two edgewise 270 x 20 x 2 mm aluminum crossmembers (58.3 g) and 39 g posts/seats/fasteners nominal; geometry and strength remain to detail

hardware.name: Four passive landing feet and compliant soles
hardware.basis: Four 10 g installed feet nominal; no caster, wheels or wheel drive

hardware.name: Keyed metal boom socket, captive station-actuated lock and sensing
hardware.basis: Root clamp/load spreader/retention allowance; through-fastened to rear bottom rail, offset right of the hex central support

hardware.name: Carbon main spar, sleeve and horizontal wrist
hardware.basis: Calculated annular stock volume at 1.6 g/cm3, rounded; see boom dimensions

hardware.name: Spar splice, elbow clamps and fasteners
hardware.basis: Two-piece clamps, positive mechanical retention and inserts; no printed long cantilever

hardware.name: Replaceable microfiber sleeve, light backing and edge hook
hardware.basis: 60 x 50 x 20 mm head allowance; dust retention and finish compatibility require tests

hardware.name: Compliant head suspension, mechanical stop and captive breakaway
hardware.basis: Provisional 0.2 N contact / 0.5 N retreat; these are targets, not established limits

hardware.name: Tip range/force sensing, carrier and short lead
hardware.basis: Sensor assembly allowance; no claim that a range sensor detects every blade or surface

hardware.name: Local MCU, CAN and hardware contact/retention interlocks

compact_layouts.evidence: Current source-matched motor/propeller curve; unmeasured guard losses; installed mass modeled

station_additions.basis: Station-side addition; carries the full robot from open apron into the exchanger after rotor stop. Existing cabinet picker does not imply a landing shuttle exists.

station_additions.name: Boom pickup, orientation adapter and vertical dry rack
station_additions.basis: Station removes/reinstalls boom at keyed root; extra rotation axis and end-effector included. Requires continuous supported handling.

station_additions.name: Enclosed microfiber comb/vacuum service pocket
station_additions.basis: Shares existing stationary vacuum; dust removal effectiveness and service interval untested

notes: No drive or autonomous ground repositioning in airborne duster mode. Passive feet support an off-station landing; recovery from a non-flyable landing may require help. This architecture must demonstrate automatic return/landing/exchange before routine deployment. The fixed core retains all its present hardware including idle floor regulators; their mass has not been removed.

ducted_comparison.allowance_basis: Retain every common quad frame/harness/flight-electronics allowance. Add separately a fan plus intake ring, ESC per fan, inlet/outlet protection and mounting per fan, and a provisional yaw-control assembly. No CAD clearance, ESC model, guard loss or yaw-control qualification is implied. Do not reduce structure simply because ducts are smaller.
ducted_comparison.curve_basis: Manufacturer stabilized-voltage sweep with small r=6 mm inlet lip, at 21 C and 50 m ASL. Linear interpolation only inside supplied data. Power versus thrust is an equivalent-operating-point estimate, not a fixed-6S partial-throttle curve. No extrapolation below the first point.
ducted_comparison.yaw_gate: These fixed EDF products have no documented matched reverse-rotation assemblies or installed net reaction-torque curve in the cited data. Do not apply the propeller quad zero-yaw mixer to them. Stator-equipped aircraft in the cited study use deflecting vanes; applicability, actuator dynamics, loss and mounting envelope must be designed here.
